description:
Non-material amendment to planning permission ref: 2022/03651/FUL granted 11th June 2025 for the 'Demolition of existing buildings at 260-262 North End Road; erection of a replacement part one, part three, part four storey, part five storey building comprising of one retail unit (Class E(a)), 394sqm office floorspace (Class E(g)) and 9 self-contained residential units (Class C3)' to allow amendments to the approved drawings to include: alterations to the main residential stair core to accommodate an 
evacuation lift, reconfiguration of access to the flats to enable the installation of a single smoke ventilated corridor at each floor level, increasing the size of the plantroom, re-configuration of the ground floor, re-configuration of Flat 5, increasing the size of the studio flats and external walls have been set out to brick dimensions.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 2 - Condition 33 Cycle parking 
The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the details of the proposed storage of 31 cycles (14 long-stay in connection with the commercial unit, and 17 long-stay in connection with the residential units) as follows:

Dwg 5580-BAL-ZZ-00-DR-A-07-0101 Rev P3 ground floor 

There development shall not be occupied until the cycle storage provision has been made in accordance with the agreed details, and it shall be permanently retained and maintained for the life Of the development.

To ensure satisfactory provision for the cycles and thereby promote sustainable and active modes of transport, in accordance with Policy T3 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 3 - Condition 39 Fire Statement 
 
The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the details contained within the approved Fire Statement (Prepared by LPEC Fire dated 30th September 2026, Rev P02). No part of the development shall be used or occupied until all mitigation, measures and means within the approved document have been implemented in full and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the building hereby approved.
 
Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Policy D12 of the London Plan (2021).
